title: Spanish Paella Risotto
description: A creative fusion of Italian risotto and Spanish paella, featuring the bold flavors of saffron and smoked paprika.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the masarepa and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth, one cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each cup to absorb before adding the next.
After 20-25 minutes of cooking, stir in the smoked paprika and saffron.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
If using, stir in the rich for added creaminess.
